      <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page-section" id="page-section-620b61e51e9eef12fa97293c"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="474bf513f7b111f21fb0" id="block-474bf513f7b111f21fb0"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Rooms</h2><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Discover our charming Diani Beach lodging at Kenyaways, a quaint beachfront hotel offering sea view accommodations in a budget beach resort setting. We have only 10 rooms, each uniquely designed with a rustic style. Five of these rooms boast stunning sea views, while the others are tucked just behind the beach. All our rooms feature private bathrooms with hot water showers, along with towels and linen provided. You'll find fan cooling and mosquito nets for your comfort, and some rooms even offer air-conditioning for added comfort. Room rates vary depending on room location, occupancy, and additional amenities like air-conditioning and size. Take a look at our galleries and room descriptions below to determine which suits you best for your affordable Kenyan beach stay.  Check out our rates below. <a href="https://portal.freetobook.com/reservations?w_id=11210&amp;w_tkn=REDACTED" target="_blank">Check Availability and Book Now Online.</a> or <a href="mailto:bookings@thekenyaway.com?subject=Room%20enquiry&amp;cc=office%40thekenyaway.com">Email us</a> for personal advise on your most suitable accommodation. Disclaimer* Air-conditioning does not work when there is power cuts.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Crossbow</h3><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><em> Sea view with Aircon</em></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">This beachfront room features two queen-sized beds, an en-suite shower and toilet, and air-conditioning. It's conveniently located on the ground floor with a small patio, making it ideal for families seeking an affordable Kenyan beach stay. Enjoy easy access to the bar and restaurant and experience a memorable Kenya beach getaway at our seaside retreat in Diani.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Sleeps maximum of 4 in twin double beds.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Rebel</h3><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><em>Superior Sea view room</em></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Experience spacious comfort at Kenyaways, a quaint Diani Beach hotel. Our first-floor beachfront room offers stunning ocean views and a terrace. It features a King-size bed, two single beds, en-suite shower and toilet, and fan-cooling. Convenient for family accommodation, this room provides access to a shared kitchenette and is located close to our superior sea view room, Tribal. Enjoy an affordable Kenyan beach stay at our oceanfront lodging in Diani.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Sleeps maximum of 4 in double bed and 2 single beds.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Raven</h3><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><em>Small Sea view with first floor balcony and kitchen access</em></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Enjoy the charm of our Diani Beach lodging at Kenyaways with this cozy first-floor beachfront room. It offers a stunning sea view from the balcony and the flexibility of a double or two single beds. The room includes an en-suite shower and toilet and provides access to a shared kitchenette. It's perfect for a couple or friends seeking an affordable Kenyan beach stay at our quaint seaside retreat in Kenya.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Sleeps a maximum of 2 in twin single or double bed.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Park</h3><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><em>Pool garden Double with aircon</em></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Enjoy a comfortable stay at Kenyaways, our quaint Diani Beach hotel, in a standard double room with air-conditioning, a double bed, and an ensuite shower and toilet. Conveniently located on the ground floor, this room is in close proximity to the pool, lounge, and neighbouring rooms like Bandit, Bolt, and Cult. Whether you're traveling as a couple or solo, it's the ideal choice for an affordable Kenyan beach stay at our seaside retreat in Kenya.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">  Sleeps maximum of 2 in double bed.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Bandit</h3><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><em>Pool garden Studio Apartment</em></p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Our spacious one-bedroom, first-floor apartment at Kenyaways is a delightful Diani Beach lodging option. This apartment offers optional extra sofa beds with mosquito nets and a fan suitable for older children. The bedroom is equipped with air conditioning, an en-suite shower, and a toilet, and there's an additional toilet outside. The basic kitchenette includes a 2-hob stove, fridge, kettle, and toaster, making it suitable for up to four guests. It's the perfect choice for an ideal holiday apartment accommodation, ensuring an affordable Kenyan beach stay at our seaside retreat in Kenya.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Sleeps maximum 4 in double bed and 2 single sofa beds.</p></div>
